tools.name: get-page
tools.title: Read an xmcp documentation page
tools.description: Read one xmcp documentation page as markdown.

id.description: Page id from search or list-pages, for example 'core-concepts/tools'

tools.name: list-pages
tools.title: List xmcp documentation pages
tools.description: List every xmcp documentation page with its id, title, and description, grouped by section. Read a page with get-page.

section.description: Limit the list to one section, for example 'core-concepts' or 'deployment'

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search xmcp documentation.
tools.description: Search the xmcp documentation. Returns the matching pages with their ids, or the page itself when only one matches. Read a listed page with get-page.
